ffi_review.contract: Typed monotonically issued run ID bound to validated document. Input byte spans are copied before nonblocking registry admission; output preflight precedes mutation and copy-out follows admission. No native pointer is a resource handle; snapshots are independently owned and survive run destruction. Native conversion, CompareNoCase, trim and all other callbacks run after all registry loans end. Reject stale/wrong kinds and invalid command/phase/flag/length/capacity; numeric parser failure is a modeled mutation, not a boundary error. Destructor releases once through the shared native gate. Unsupplied screen remains unresolved.

ffi_review.contract: Extends existing noncopyable AssStyle RAII owner, with exclusive live owner precondition. Native inputs are initialized, bounded, disjoint u16 spans and copied immediately. Scalars carry exact native conversion results; float uses bits. No writable native object pointer is retained. Existing scalar copy-out API returns encoded result bytes/name units; one native style value is decoded after finish. Four new unsafe entrypoints; native owner lifetime remains an audited transitional precondition, not a checked integer handle. Encoded result limited to u32 byte count.
